name: Through Moonbrook

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic Alliance quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

summary: The next assignment is an escort through Moonbrook with the traitor leading the way to the hideout. The militia enters familiar Westfall ground now shadowed by the enemy’s presence. No individual adventurer is made the hero of a history they were never named in; the scene follows the objective and leaves the exact path open.
